items.title: Securitize Posts Loss in First Earnings Report After NYSE Debut
items.summary: Securitize, the BlackRock-backed tokenization firm, said its second-quarter losses widened from a year ago, hit by a sharp downturn in the broader crypto market.  Quarterly revenue fell 5% to $14.4 million from $15.3 million in the year-ago period.  It made its public debut on the New York Stock Exchange last month after merging with a special-purpose acquisition company sponsored by Cantor Fitzgerald.
